worked_exemplar.dag_derived_lesson: A forecast should consider the interplay between fundamental drivers like earnings expectations and macroeconomic factors such as monetary policy and policy uncertainty. When these factors present conflicting signals, the resulting market movement is likely to be less extreme than if all signals pointed in the same direction.
